subject.title: Add DI composition root and navigation/activation seam for tray view models

question: Should the repository adopt this DI/navigation ownership boundary now, before any tray page is migrated to a view model?
rationale: The patch is additive and well-proven, but accepting an authoritative composition root and navigation-scope owner is an architectural direction choice that cannot be resolved solely by tests.

options.title: Accept the boundary
options.body: Merge the infrastructure as the approved foundation for future incremental page-view-model migrations while preserving HubWindow’s existing navigation ownership.

options.title: Defer until first migration
options.body: Keep the PR open or close it for now and require the first concrete page migration to establish only the abstractions it demonstrably needs.

recommendation.title: Accept the boundary
recommendation.body: Merge the infrastructure as the approved foundation for future incremental page-view-model migrations while preserving HubWindow’s existing navigation ownership.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied maintainer-review context defines the lifecycle invariants and is the strongest available signal for the architectural acceptance decision.
